description: Get the authenticated Pinterest user account details.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'user_account' and the user_account details; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get aggregate analytics for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by date range.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive lower bound date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter analytics rows by.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive upper bound date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter analytics rows by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, count, and a results list of daily analytics rows; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List boards, optionally filtered by privacy, with pagination.

privacy.description: Optional privacy filter (e.g. PUBLIC, SECRET) to restrict returned boards.

limit.description: Maximum number of boards to return per page (default 25).

offset.description: Number of boards to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of board objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single board by its id.

board_id.description: The unique id of the board.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'board' and the board details; on failure (board not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new board with a name and optional description and privacy.

name.description: The name of the new board (required).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'board' and the created board; on failure (missing name), output contains an error message.

description: Update an existing board's name, description, or privacy.

board_id.description: The unique id of the board to update.

name.description: Optional new name for the board.

description.description: Optional new description for the board.

privacy.description: Optional new privacy setting for the board.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'board' and the updated board; on failure (board not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a board by its id.

board_id.description: The unique id of the board to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'board', deleted true, and the board_id; on failure (board not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the pins belonging to a board, with pagination.

board_id.description: The unique id of the board whose pins to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return per page (default 25).

offset.description: Number of pins to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of pin objects; on failure (board not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the sections belonging to a board.

board_id.description: The unique id of the board whose sections to list.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, count, and a results list of board section objects; on failure (board not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new section within a board.

board_id.description: The unique id of the board to add the section to.

name.description: The name of the new board section (required).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'board_section' and the created section; on failure (board not found or missing name), output contains an error message.

description: List the pins belonging to a specific section of a board, with pagination.

board_id.description: The unique id of the board.

section_id.description: The unique id of the board section whose pins to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return per page (default 25).

offset.description: Number of pins to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of pin objects; on failure (board or section not found), output contains an error message.

description: List all pins for the authenticated user, with pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return per page (default 25).

offset.description: Number of pins to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of pin objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single pin by its id.

pin_id.description: The unique id of the pin.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'pin' and the pin details; on failure (pin not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new pin on a board with a title and optional metadata.

board_id.description: The id of the board to create the pin on (required).

title.description: The title of the new pin (required).

link.description: Optional destination link for the pin.

board_section_id.description: Optional id of the board section to place the pin in.

dominant_color.description: Optional dominant color hex string (defaults to #FFFFFF).

alt_text.description: Optional alternative text for the pin.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'pin' and the created pin; on failure (missing field or board not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update an existing pin's title, description, link, board, section, or alt text.

pin_id.description: The unique id of the pin to update.

title.description: Optional new title for the pin.

description.description: Optional new description for the pin.

link.description: Optional new destination link for the pin.

board_id.description: Optional new board id to move the pin to.

board_section_id.description: Optional new board section id for the pin.

alt_text.description: Optional new alternative text for the pin.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'pin' and the updated pin; on failure (pin not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a pin by its id.

pin_id.description: The unique id of the pin to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'pin', deleted true, and the pin_id; on failure (pin not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get analytics for a single pin, optionally filtered by date range.

pin_id.description: The unique id of the pin.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive lower bound date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter analytics rows by.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive upper bound date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter analytics rows by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, count, pin_id, and a results list of daily analytics rows; on failure (pin not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search pins by matching a query against pin titles and descriptions, with pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return per page (default 25).

offset.description: Number of pins to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of matching pin objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the upload status of a media item by its id.

media_id.description: The unique id of the media item.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, media_id, status, and media_type; on failure (media not found), output contains an error message.

description: List ad accounts available to the authenticated user, with pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of ad accounts to return per page (default 25).

offset.description: Number of ad accounts to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of ad account objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single ad account by its id.

ad_account_id.description: The unique id of the ad account.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type 'ad_account' and the ad account details; on failure (ad account not found), output contains an error message.

description: List campaigns for an ad account, optionally filtered by status, with pagination.

ad_account_id.description: The unique id of the ad account whose campaigns to list.

status.description: Optional status filter (e.g. ACTIVE, PAUSED) to restrict returned campaigns.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return per page (default 25).

offset.description: Number of campaigns to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with type, count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of campaign objects; on failure (ad account not found), output contains an error message.
